items.title: Elf Comparing Green Fabrics
items.alt: Copper-curled cartoon elf in a green waistcoat and red shorts holding plain and patterned green fabric beside three thread spools.
items.description: A cream measuring tape drapes over the patterned cloth. The elf compares its holly-and-scroll design with a plain dark-green piece held in the other hand.

items.title: Elf Folding a Red Paper Lantern
items.alt: Dark-braided cartoon elf seated cross-legged, folding a red accordion-paper lantern beside a finished gold lantern and two paper strips.
items.description: The elf pinches the red folds above striped knees. A red-banded green cap, cream cuffs and gold bells on the curled shoes distinguish the paper-craft scene.
